<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="photoSky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="48%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4A4A4A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="photoShade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".46"/>
      <stop offset="38%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".08"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".62"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="buttonGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#photoSky)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#D0CECD" opacity=".18"/>
  <circle cx="302" cy="155" r="58" fill="#EFC54D" opacity=".58"/>
  <polygon points="0,420 84,327 139,382 220,286 390,444 390,844 0,844" fill="#4A4A4A" opacity=".72"/>
  <polygon points="0,511 79,426 145,493 240,371 390,526 390,844 0,844" fill="#000000" opacity=".28"/>
  <polygon points="0,610 112,497 186,560 270,473 390,603 390,844 0,844" fill="#000000" opacity=".32"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#photoShade)"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="27" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="25" x2="329" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="22" x2="335" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="338" y1="19" x2="341" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="23" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="27" x2="361" y2="30" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="368" y="18" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="370" y="20" width="13" height="7" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="388" y="21" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- top camera controls -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="30" cy="79" r="21" fill="#000000" opacity=".28"/>
    <polyline points="36,71 28,79 36,87" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="79" x2="42" y2="79" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <circle cx="333" cy="79" r="21" fill="#000000" opacity=".28"/>
    <circle cx="333" cy="73" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="78" x2="333" y2="88" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="327" y1="83" x2="339" y2="83" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="329" y1="88" x2="337" y2="88" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <circle cx="375" cy="79" r="21" fill="#000000" opacity=".28"/>
    <polyline points="368,74 374,70 381,75 381,85 374,89 368,85 368,74" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="371,76 377,79 371,83 371,76" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- guidance -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="128" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#FFFFFF">Take a verification photo</text>
    <text x="195" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Center your face in the frame</text>
    <circle cx="195" cy="364" r="126" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity=".86"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="239" x2="195" y2="260" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="468" x2="195" y2="489" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="70" y1="364" x2="91" y2="364" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="299" y1="364" x2="320" y2="364" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- face guide -->
  <g opacity=".84">
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="345" rx="48" ry="63" fill="#D9D9D9" opacity=".18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="177" cy="340" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="213" cy="340" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="345" x2="191" y2="360" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="184" y1="378" x2="206" y2="378" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom camera controls -->
  <rect x="0" y="646" width="390" height="198" fill="#000000" opacity=".48"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="58" cy="711" r="31" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="40" y="696" width="36" height="30" rx="5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="58" cy="711" r="9" fill="#939393" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="68" cy="702" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="58" y="759" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Preview</text>

    <circle cx="195" cy="710" r="42" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".22"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="710" r="32" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="710" r="25" fill="url(#buttonGradient)"/>

    <circle cx="332" cy="711" r="31" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="320,703 328,696 340,696 347,704 347,717 339,726 326,726 319,718 319,706" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="326,705 338,717" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="338,705 326,717" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="332" y="759" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="normal" fill="#FFFFFF">Switch</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="69" y="782" width="252" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".96"/>
    <text x="195" y="807" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#4A4A4A">USE THIS PHOTO</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="824" width="390" height="20" fill="#000000" opacity=".62"/>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <polygon points="32,836 40,829 48,836 46,836 46,842 35,842 35,836" opacity=".9"/>
    <text x="40" y="853" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="9" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
    <circle cx="116" cy="834" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="839" x2="126" y2="843" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="116" y="853" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="9" fill="#FFFFFF">Discover</text>
    <circle cx="195" cy="834" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="191,834 194,837 200,830" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="195" y="853" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="9" fill="#FFFFFF">Verify</text>
    <rect x="265" y="829" width="13" height="10" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polygon points="268,839 267,843 272,839" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="271" y="853" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="9" fill="#FFFFFF">Chats</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="833" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="842" rx="8" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="350" y="853" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="9" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
